facts.fact: Tigglestide 前夜众人回家团聚，Greg 独自留在办公室摆弄 Round Robin v2.8 Beta 的残骸；因为有备份，Jessica 砸毁原型机并未终结项目。
facts.anchor: but Greg remained alone in his work office, tinkering with the remains of Round Robin v2.8 Beta. Of course, there were backups. Leave it to Jessica to believe that she could destroy the whole project by breaking the prototype

facts.fact: 市长临走时邀请 Greg 去酒馆喝一杯：伙伴们总要在 The Stoat and Hare 喝上几轮，给 Tigglestide 庆典收尾。
facts.anchor: said the lord mayor as he had left. “It’s Tigglestide Eve. If you won’t go home, won’t you at least come down to the pub for a pint? The lads always end the festivities with a few rounds at The Stoat and Hare.”

facts.fact: Greg 的中年体面自我规训：鄙视那些把钱砸在植发和红色法拉利上、抛妻弃子、把人生搞砸的同龄人。
facts.anchor: Greg had friends who suddenly dropped money that they didn’t have on hair plugs and red Ferraris (they were always red), who left their wives and children

facts.fact: Greg 自认终究会回到 Jessica 身边、一向都会回去——因为他无处可去；他为她的笃定而恼火，又不得不承认她是对的。
facts.anchor: Of course he was going to go back to her. He was always going to return. There was no place else for him to go.

facts.fact: 地下酒馆的酒保戴着又红又湿、像刚刷过漆的面具：没有可见的嘴，只有两只凸出的眼睛。
facts.anchor: The barkeep wore a mask that was red and wet, as if it had just been freshly painted

facts.fact: Greg 认出扮装人群：穿裙带妆的邮差皮特、戴狗面具的牧师、警察、养蜂人，以及哑剧里扮演 Round Robin 的床单双人组。
facts.anchor: Greg spied Postman Pete, still in his dress and makeup, and the vicar, in a dog mask, and the constable, his cheeks painted with red spots like Robert the bobby, and the beekeeper, still wearing his wicker basket, and, strangely, the two men under the sheet who played Round Robin during the Tigglestide pantomime.

facts.fact: 市长拨动开关，报废的机器竟复活；他高呼这是真正的 Tigglestide 奇迹，宣布 Greg 果然是「对的那类人」。
facts.anchor: A true Tigglestide miracle! What did I tell you, lads? He really is the right sort of people!

facts.fact: 市长清点这家的失礼账：Greg 的妻子前夜着装不雅、当着孩子们袭击小丑，还整晚挂着他的 Molly。
facts.anchor: your wife dressing so inappropriately on Tigglestide Eve and assaulting a clown in full view of the children—a shocking public display! Most improper. Certainly not something that the right sort of person would do. And, of course, the entire village has taken notice of how she hangs off of my Molly.
